items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Is Earle still around? ... Oh, so Earle wrote “Harlem Nocturne,” good piece. ... very inventive composer, did a lot of those good things like, “Mod Squad,”

ctx.x: He used to give a lot of seminars for film and TV composers didn’t he?
I'm not sure I haven't heard anything about him…
